description: The select case for Vue (v-model, and :value with @change): options from a v-for list and a v-if option, a disabled option, an uncontrolled select (option values from collapsed text), programmatic values, a value no option has showing none (setSelected), keyboard changes on a focused closed select (arrows skipping disabled options, Home, End, typeahead). Vue differs from Svelte for a :value nothing writes: Vue patches a select's value at every re-render of its component where the live value differs, so the user's choice stays until an unrelated update re-renders the component and is then restored
